variable Chosen = ""
list Journal = []
variable Saved = 0 (remembered)
list People = ["Ana","Ben"] (remembered)
table Kinds = [kind] 2 rows
table Clips = [note, n, picture, sound, kind (links to Kinds)] 1 row (remembered)
all screens
event: when HomeBtn is clicked | do: Call Bump with by = 1; Go to screen Choose
function Bump(by)
event: always | do: Add by to variable Saved
screen Choose
object Title (text) text "Values journal"
object Prompt (text) text "Which value did you show today?"
object KindnessPicture (image) text "Kindness"
object KindnessButton (button) text "Kindness"
object CouragePicture (image) text "Courage"
object CourageButton (button) text "Courage"
object HonestyPicture (image) text "Honesty"
object HonestyButton (button) text "Honesty"
object RespectPicture (image) text "Respect"
object RespectButton (button) text "Respect"
event: when KindnessButton is clicked | do: Set variable Chosen to "Kindness"; Go to screen Describe
event: when CourageButton is clicked | do: Set variable Chosen to "Courage"; Go to screen Describe
event: when HonestyButton is clicked | do: Set variable Chosen to "Honesty"; Go to screen Describe
event: when RespectButton is clicked | do: Set variable Chosen to "Respect"; Go to screen Describe
screen Describe
object Question (text) text ""
object TextInput (text input) text ""
object AddButton (button) text "Add to my journal"
event: when On start of screen | do: Set Question text to "What did you do to show " & Chosen & "?"
event: when AddButton is clicked | do: Add uppercase(Chosen) & ": " & TextInput.text to the end of list Journal; Go to screen Journal
screen Journal
object Heading (text) text "My values in action"
object Count (text) text ""
object List (list) text "" shows Journal
object AnotherButton (button) text "Add another"
event: when On start of screen | do: Set Count text to "Entries: " & count(Journal)
event: when AnotherButton is clicked | do: Go to screen Choose
screen Media
object Pad (drawing) text ""
object Cam (photo) text ""
object Mic (recorder) text ""
object Player (sound) text "" sound calm
object Clip (video) text "" link "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Example.webm"
object Show (image) text ""
object KeepBtn (button) text "Button"
object HomeBtn (button) text "Button"
object Msg (text) text "Text"
object Gallery (table) text "" shows Clips
object Names (list) text "" shows People
event: when Pad is drawn on | do: Set Msg text to "lines: " & Pad.lines
event: when KeepBtn is clicked | do: Add a row to table Clips: note = "drawn", n = Saved, picture = Pad.picture, kind = "drawing"; Set Show picture to the one in Pad.picture; Clear Pad
event: when A photo is taken with Cam | do: Add a row to table Clips: note = "photo", n = 0, picture = Cam.picture, kind = "photo"
event: when Mic finishes a recording | do: Set Player sound to the one named Mic.sound; Play Player
